source.title: Flexible molecular chameleons: structural adaptability and therapeutic applications

rules.statement: Classically molecules with 2D TPSA > 140 A^2 are poorly membrane-permeable; molecular chameleons are exceptions because their conformation adapts to solvent polarity.

source.title: Systematic benchmarking of 13 AI methods for predicting cyclic peptide membrane permeability

rules.statement: Adding logP and TPSA as auxiliary tasks to deep-learning permeability models did not significantly improve prediction in a 13-model benchmark, likely because they do not capture conformational features.
